Run-wide checks still flag unrelated scaffold issues: 40 empty future-page inventories and six item-level mismatches (`post-qftx-n2-vector-hypermultiplet-model`, `post-qftx-n4-super-yang-mills-model`, `ex-qftx-n2-hypermultiplet-gauge-invariants`, `ex-qftx-n2-quadratic-prepotential`, `ex-qftx-n4-adjoint-hyper-decomposition`, `ex-qftx-n4-su2-noncommuting-scalar-potential`). These findings are recorded in the batch notes.
